items.q: How do computers store all data?
items.random_wrong: As letters of the alphabet directly.
items.why: Everything (numbers, text, images, sound) is ultimately stored as binary.

items.q: How many bits are in a byte?
items.why: 1 byte = 8 bits; a nibble is 4 bits; 1000-ish bytes is a kilobyte.

items.q: What affects the file size of an image?
items.correct: Resolution (number of pixels) and colour depth.
items.misconception: Only the size of the screen showing it.
items.why: File size ≈ resolution × colour depth; more pixels or more bits per pixel means a bigger file.
